pages.title: Five Banners Online
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Five Banners Online sends you onto a floating island to gather materials, battle monsters, and bring resources back to safety. Reach the safe zone to convert your haul into useful supplies, then use crafting and equipment to prepare for another expedition. Other players can join a fight or interfere with your plans by knocking items from your backpack.

The island eventually starts collapsing into the abyss, putting a deadline on exploration and collecting. Each cycle changes the island you explore, while your base and equipment carry over. Choosing when to return becomes as important as deciding where to search next.

pages.title: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 7
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Solitaire Story Tripeaks 7 combines card-clearing puzzles with a journey through destinations around the world. Remove exposed cards that sit one rank above or below the current stock card, building a sequence that clears the layout. Draw another stock card when you need a different starting point, but finish the board before the stock runs out.

Beyond the main layouts, the game includes seasonal card collections, daily missions and events such as Bingo and Digging. These activities provide prizes and boosters for the card puzzles. Plan which exposed card to remove next, considering how that choice might let you continue the sequence without spending another draw.

pages.title: Topsy Turvy
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Topsy Turvy is a cannon-based matching puzzle with a spooky theme. Aim at a moving chain of eyeballs and skull-like orbs, firing matching shots to clear the track before the chain reaches the drain. Click or tap where you want the cannon to send an orb. Build combinations as you remove sections of the chain and try to keep it from crawling too close to the end.

pages.title: Zombie Rush
pages.creator: SqueakyGamesInc
pages.description: Zombie Rush is a top-down survival shooter about a lone survivor facing an endless zombie horde. Move around trees and weave away from the undead while fighting to stay alive. The waves become more dangerous as the horde evolves, putting pressure on both your movement and your ability to keep space around the survivor. Use WASD, the arrow keys or a held mouse drag to move; touch dragging provides another way to lead the character.

pages.title: Europe at War
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Europe at War is a turn-based strategy game that begins in 1936. Choose a nation and manage its position on a map of Europe, balancing warfare, diplomacy and industrial development. Victory can come from conquering the regions, uniting Europe through alliances or developing an economy with twelve factories.

Each turn represents a month. Regions and factories produce gold, barracks recruit troops and airfields support aviation. Declare war through Diplomacy before launching an attack, then select troops and their target region. Movement and attacks consume troop energy, so consider those limits when planning a campaign. Build income and military strength while deciding which route to victory best suits your nation.

pages.title: Seat Puzzle Cut The Rope
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Seat Puzzle Cut The Rope is a color-based puzzle in which ropes bind the chairs. Use clicks or taps to cut the ropes according to the passengers' colors. Look at the arrangement and the colors before choosing what to cut, working out how to handle the chairs required by each level's passengers.

pages.title: Valentines Love Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Valentines Love Link is a tile-connection puzzle filled with hearts, roses, chocolates and other Valentine symbols. Select matching items that can be joined by an unobstructed path with no more than two turns. Remove every pair before the countdown ends to finish the level. Work through 48 layouts, checking how each cleared pair opens more space for the remaining connections.

pages.title: Bubble Around
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Bubble Around puts you inside the bubble arrangement rather than firing into it from one edge. Shoot outward into the surrounding field and connect at least three matching bubbles to pop them. Clear all the bubbles to finish a level, then take on another arrangement. Bomb, rocket and multicolor power-ups can help with difficult sections as the level shapes become more challenging.

pages.title: Onet Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Onet Mahjong Connect is a tile-pairing puzzle about finding identical pictures that can be linked together. A pair is available when its connection uses at most three straight segments. Select matching tiles with the mouse or touchpad and work through the arrangement, looking for legal routes between the remaining pairs as you progress through the levels.

pages.title: Mr Disc: Slingshot Strike
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Mr Disc: Slingshot Strike is an action game about throwing discs through enemies and breakable obstacles. Swipe to send a disc along your chosen line and knock down the targets in its path. Work out where to aim so the throw helps clear the level, using the discs to deal with both opponents and the barriers standing ahead.

pages.title: Tile Connect Pair Match Puzzle
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Tile Connect Pair Match Puzzle asks you to find identical objects among a selection of tiles. Click matching objects to pair them and work toward completing the puzzle. Compare the different item types on the board as you search for the next pair, keeping the matching objects together in your choices.

pages.title: Fix The Hoof
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Fix The Hoof is a 3D hoof-care simulation featuring animals such as horses, cows and goats. Work as the hoof specialist, clicking the interactive tools to clean, polish and paint each animal's hooves. The care tasks combine cleaning with choosing a fresh appearance for the finished hoof.

Your work earns money that can go toward farm improvements and expanding the collection of animals you look after. Complete the services and develop the farm as you take on more hoof-care jobs.

pages.title: My Farm
pages.creator: Playtox Limited Liability Company
pages.description:
My Farm is a farming game that combines growing crops, caring for animals, fishing and production. Develop the property and manufacture new types of goods while completing tasks. There is also a zoo where you can assemble a collection of exotic animals, alongside visitors and adventures to discover.

Build up the farm's activities and pursue rewards such as chests, animals and decorative items. The different jobs give you several parts of the farm to develop, from its fields and animal care to the goods you produce.

pages.title: Solitaire L'Amour
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Solitaire L'Amour is a romantic-themed card-clearing game. Select an exposed card from the tableau when its value is one rank higher or lower than the stock card. Each removal changes the value you can play against next. Work through the face-up choices and clear the entire tableau, looking for sequences that let you remove several cards in succession.

pages.title: Cube in Cube
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Cube in Cube is a number-merging puzzle with an endless challenge and a monkey-rescue objective. Click a cube, then select an adjacent matching cube to combine the pair into a higher-level one. Study the neighboring values before choosing your merge, developing the arrangement as you work toward clearing cubes or helping the monkey in the selected challenge.

pages.title: Blocksss
pages.creator: Sixcube
pages.description: Blocksss is a minimalist shape-fitting puzzle about filling a square with blocks. Drag the available pieces into the board and work out how their edges fit together. Compare each shape with the remaining spaces, adjusting your placements until the square is filled. The challenge comes from finding an arrangement that accommodates the whole set of pieces.

pages.title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description:
GT Cars Mega Ramps combines customized exotic cars with large ramps, giant bosses and face-to-face racing stages. Launch the car over ramps, take on the bosses or compete to finish a race first. The different challenges put the same cars into both stunt driving and competitive runs.

For a single player, use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, Left Shift for nitro, R to reset the car and C to change the camera. A two-player option assigns WASD to the first driver and the arrow keys to the second, with separate nitro and reset controls for each.

pages.title: Horseback Survival
pages.creator: Cubehole
pages.description:
Horseback Survival is a zombie survival adventure starring Zohan and his horse, Badal. After a mysterious event leaves Zohan in a coma, their shared journey leads into a world overrun by the undead. Fight with melee and ranged attacks, move quietly when stealth is useful and use running and jumping to get past obstacles.

On a keyboard, A and D move, Space jumps and Shift runs. Combat also uses the left side of the screen: click there for a melee attack, or hold and drag to aim before releasing a shot. Mobile controls provide a movement joystick and a jump button.

pages.title: Mr Throw
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description:
Mr Throw turns everyday junk into weapons for a throwing duel. Aim at your opponent and choose the strength and direction of the throw to take away as much of their health as possible. The item is selected automatically, so work with whatever object comes to hand, even an old teddy bear.

On a computer, hold the right mouse button to lay out the trajectory; touch controls use a held finger. Your own projectile can also intercept an incoming object or alter its path, with the objects' relative weight affecting the clash. Consider both the attack and the object heading toward you when lining up a throw.

pages.title: Paint It
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Paint It turns coloring into a timed competition. Color the figures while trying to outperform your opponent before the time limit expires. Work through the pictures and their coloring tasks with the clock in mind, balancing the work still needed on your image against the pace of the rival's progress.

pages.title: Flip Skater Rush 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Flip Skater Rush 3D puts two skateboarders under your control at once. Slide to adjust their positions so both can pass the obstacles along the route. Watch the space available to each skater before moving the pair, since a position that works for one needs to leave the other clear as well.

pages.title: Delete Puzzle Erase One Part
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Delete Puzzle Erase One Part is a visual puzzle game where removing something from the picture provides the answer. Read the problem for the scene and swipe over the extra part to erase it. Each level presents a different situation, so examine the drawing for the detail that should disappear to restore the intended scene.

pages.title: Pirates and Cannons Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description:
Pirates and Cannons Multi player is a fleet battle about arranging your ships and sinking the opposing fleet. Drag items into position, tap to rotate them and confirm the setup with the green check mark. When attacking, drag the target into place and watch the strike resolve before choosing the next one.

Weapons include torpedoes, triple bombs and dynamite attacks from above. Finding treasure provides rewards, and the shop offers further items. Keep the turn's time limit in mind as you target the enemy. The exchange continues until a fleet has been sunk or its lives are exhausted.

pages.title: Tallman Dunk Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tallman Dunk Rush combines running with reaching a basketball dunk. Drag to steer the runner into shorter players while staying away from obstacles taller than your character. Judge the relative heights along the route and choose which targets to hit as you advance. The aim is to get through the run in a position to dunk the ball successfully.

pages.title: BFF Art Class
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: BFF Art Class is a school-preparation makeover game. One of the girls is in a hurry, looks untidy and needs help getting ready for the day. Use the mouse to give her a makeover and choose a school outfit. Put together a finished look from the fashion choices as you help her prepare to join her friends.

pages.title: Zrist DX
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Zrist DX is an obstacle-dodging game where the rules keep changing. Jump and slide through the challenges, adapting to the current rules while collecting points that can be exchanged for skins. The game includes seven rule variations across its levels. On a computer, X or the left mouse button jumps and C or the right button slides; on touch controls, use the right side to jump and the left to slide.

pages.title: Semi Truck Snow Simulator
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Semi Truck Snow Simulator challenges you to drive a large truck through snowy mountain terrain. Work your way along steep slopes and difficult trails, using WASD or the arrow keys to control the vehicle. The objective is to see how far you can travel, keeping the semi under control as the mountain routes test your driving.

pages.title: SPACE SHIP HUNTING
pages.creator: rose91petals
pages.description: SPACE SHIP HUNTING is a space shooter about keeping your ship alive while fighting enemy craft. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and fire bullets with Space or the left mouse button. Deal with the ships and projectiles around you while building your score, trying to beat your previous best as you continue the fight.

pages.title: Mahjong Restaurant
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Mahjong Restaurant is a tile-clearing puzzle where you remove matching pairs that are open for play. Each pair you clear can uncover tiles beneath it, changing which matches are available next. Work through the layered arrangement and keep looking for accessible identical tiles. The game is complete when every pair has been removed and the board is empty.

pages.title: Parkour Game 3D
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Parkour Game 3D is a platforming challenge with courses that become harder as you progress. Move across the platforms and time your jumps to work through each scenario. WASD controls movement, Space jumps and P pauses the game. The levels test careful positioning and patience as you try to complete their increasingly demanding routes.

pages.title: Shape Shift Run
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Shape Shift Run asks you to change a jelly-like shape to match the obstacles ahead. Click or tap to transform it, choosing the required shape in time to pass through the next challenge. React quickly as the route continues, checking what form is needed before you reach the obstacle and changing again when the requirement shifts.

pages.title: Hawaii Match 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Hawaii Match 3 is a matching puzzle set among Hawaiian islands, with exotic fruit and flowers to collect. Make groups of matching items to complete the board's tasks and clear obstacles such as stones. Larger combinations provide stronger power-ups, giving you more ways to deal with difficult sections.

Work through the island journey while completing the collection goals. Daily missions and challenges add further objectives and rewards, including coins and gifts, alongside the main sequence of matching levels.

pages.title: Align 4 BIG
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Align 4 BIG is a turn-based connection game about making a line of four matching counters. Choose a column and drop your disc into the lowest free position, then wait for the opposing move. Win by completing a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line before your opponent. Consider both the space your disc occupies and the position it leaves available above it.

pages.title: Where is the Water
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Where is the Water is a physics puzzle about getting enough water to a small crocodile. Drag the terrain and move objects to form a route for the flow, working around the level's obstacles and mechanisms. Collect stars as you solve the arrangement and guide the water between the required points. Each new layout asks you to rethink how the water can reach its destination.

pages.title: TankWar.io
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: TankWar.io is a tank battle game focused on surviving while defeating other tanks. Control your vehicle through the battlefield and collect equipment scattered around the map to improve it. Keep developing the tank as you engage the opposition, balancing the search for useful gear with the need to stay alive against the other vehicles.

pages.title: Pentomino
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Pentomino is a shape-fitting puzzle using pieces made from five connected squares. Choose a target figure from the right side of the screen, then drag the pentomino pieces into place to reproduce it. Compare the corners and outlines of the pieces with the spaces in the target, working out how the five-square shapes can fit together into the required figure.

pages.title: Candy Blocks
pages.creator: MURAT KYABISHEV
pages.description:
Candy Blocks challenges you to place candy-shaped pieces on a chocolate board and complete lines. A row or column of six candies clears and awards 100 points. Drag shapes from the bottom into the field, planning placements around the spaces left by earlier pieces.

The rules change after you reach 500 points, when a countdown begins. Coins let you rotate or replace one of the offered figures, and the sweetie smiley can clear an area. Use those options to help with awkward gaps while continuing to complete lines and build your score.

pages.title: Hurdles Heroes
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Hurdles Heroes is a hurdle-racing tournament across seven continents. Time your jumps to clear each barrier and gain speed by jumping at the last moment. Try to finish first in every destination to win the tournament. Play alone or use the two-player option: the first runner jumps with W and the second uses the Up arrow, making jump timing the shared focus of the race.

pages.title: Incredible Princess Eye Art 2
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Incredible Princess Eye Art 2 is a makeup game centered on artistic designs around the eyes. Use the brushes and available effects to create looks inspired by angel makeup, rhinestones, animal prints and neon styles. Click or tap to apply the choices, trying different combinations as you give the princesses a distinctive eye-makeup design.

pages.title: Casual Weekend Fashionistas
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Casual Weekend Fashionistas is a dress-up game about creating weekend looks for Ariel and Elsa. Start with a hairstyle, then combine tops and bottoms into an outfit for each friend. Add a jacket and finish with accessories to bring the choices together. Use the mouse to try different combinations as you give both girls a casual style for their weekend plans.

pages.title: Levi's Face Plastic Surgery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Levi's Face Plastic Surgery is a fictional treatment game about a prince with facial scarring after an accident. Use the mouse to follow the facial-surgery tasks, helping the doctor carry out the treatment in the on-screen scenario. Work through the game's procedure to help Levi complete his post-accident transformation.

pages.title: Maze And Tourist
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Maze And Tourist combines navigating mazes with a journey through fifteen African countries. Guide the tourist through each country's level and discover information about the destination along the way. The game introduces the country's name, flag, coat of arms, capital, language and a notable attraction. Solve the maze routes as you continue the trip and move on to another country.

pages.title: Line Side
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Line Side is a reflex game about keeping a circle away from square obstacles along a line. Tap to switch the circle between the left and right sides, choosing the moment that leaves it clear of the next square. Switching too early or too late can cause a collision. Continue avoiding the squares as you try to improve your score.

pages.title: Super Sandy World
pages.creator: CrazyGames
pages.description: Super Sandy World is a platform adventure with straightforward movement and jumping controls. Use the Left and Right arrow keys to run and Space to jump as you make your way through the adventure. Navigate the platforms and work toward completing the route, adjusting where you land before continuing onward through the world.

pages.title: Family Clash
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Family Clash is a survey-based trivia game built around answers given by an audience of 100 people. Read an everyday question and try to identify its five most popular responses. Score points across three rounds by finding the answers the audience chose. The challenge is thinking about common responses rather than looking only for one factually correct answer.

pages.title: Prehistoric Defense
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Prehistoric Defense puts you in command of a stone-age army protecting its home from dinosaurs and other enemies. Click the warrior icons to deploy your fighters, defend your own base and attack the enemy's home. Destroy that opposing base to advance to the next level. Further progress unlocks new warriors to add to the forces defending your settlement.

pages.title: Wave Run
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Wave Run is an obstacle-avoidance game about controlling a ball through changing hazards. Use the mouse or a finger to interact with the ball and keep it clear of the objects in its way. The obstacles appear in random arrangements, so watch for openings as you adjust your movement and try to continue through the next section.

pages.title: Desert Car Racing
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Desert Car Racing is a driving game with ten levels and eight cars that have different performance characteristics. Work through the challenges to unlock additional stages and vehicles. The keyboard controls use Left and Right to move and A and D to adjust the car's balance. Touch buttons and gamepad input are also supported, giving you different ways to tackle the desert driving courses.

pages.title: Christmas Capital Letters
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Christmas Capital Letters is a letter-recognition game where you should tap only the uppercase letters. React quickly enough to catch the correct ones while leaving lowercase letters alone. Keep track of missed letters and incorrect selections: the game has allowances of ten misses and three mistakes. Aim for a higher score while staying within those limits.

pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: 123 is a counting game that uses pictures of fingers to represent numbers. Count the fingers shown and click the corresponding number from the choices. The task connects a visible quantity with its written numeral, letting you work through the number questions by looking carefully at each hand picture.

pages.title: Find Game
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Find Game is a visual-memory puzzle about identifying a hidden object. Examine the items shown and use what you remember to make your choice. The focus is noticing and recognizing the object you are looking for, comparing the available pictures as you work through the search task.

pages.title: Drift Race 3D
pages.creator: ArcadeGears
pages.description: Drift Race 3D is an arcade driving game about using drifts to complete a race. Click to trigger the car's drifting action, choosing the moment that helps it follow the course. Keep working toward the finish line as you judge the route and adjust your timing, aiming to turn a controlled drift into a successful race.

pages.title: Empire Rush Rome Wars Tower Defense
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description:
Empire Rush Rome Wars Tower Defense combines castle defense with collecting cards and developing an army. Protect Rome against barbarian hordes, choosing how to use your units and strengthen the castle's defenses. The army includes Roman fighters such as legionaries, praetorian guards and archers.

Collect cards and merge units to develop your defensive force as you take on the battles. Castle upgrades provide another way to prepare for the attacks, while bosses add further opponents to overcome. Build a strategy around the forces you have available and keep the enemy from bringing down the empire's defenses.

pages.title: Amazing Colors
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Amazing Colors is a floor-painting puzzle where you swipe in a direction to spread color across the layout. Cover the floor using as few moves as possible, choosing a route that reaches the unpainted spaces efficiently. Think about where each swipe will take the color before committing to it, then try to improve the move count of your solution.

pages.title: Animal House
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Animal House is an animal-and-habitat matching game. Look at the animal and click the natural home that corresponds to it. Compare the habitat choices with the animal shown, choosing the environment where it belongs. The task focuses on recognizing those relationships as you work through the animal pictures.

pages.title: Sum Square
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description:
Sum Square is an addition puzzle where every colored box has a target total. Drag the number pieces into the boxes so each box's contents add up to its required value. As the layouts grow more complicated, pay attention to the areas where boxes intersect and how your placements affect the different totals.

Click the number boxes at the top to highlight a boundary when the overlapping colors are difficult to follow. The game contains sixty levels, with a solutions button available through the main menu if you need help. Keep checking all the target sums as you arrange the numbers.

pages.title: Prison Escape Plan
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Prison Escape Plan is a route-planning puzzle about helping wrongly imprisoned people find a way out. Use the mouse to draw an escape path for the prisoners, working around the police and obstacles in each layout. Consider where the route takes them before sending them onward, aiming to guide the group safely through the escape and complete the level.

pages.title: Slither.io : Snake io game
pages.creator: 6woo.com
pages.description: Slither.io : Snake io game puts a growing snake into an arena with rival creatures and edible pickups. Guide the snake around the field, collect food and develop it while trying to stay alive. The game includes boosters and a progression system with levels and unlockable skins.

pages.title: Horse Racing Games 2020 Derby Riding Race 3d
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Horse Racing Games 2020 Derby Riding Race 3d puts you in the jockey's role for a horse-racing challenge. Ride against competing jockeys and work toward winning the race. Follow the game's on-screen instructions to control the horse, keeping your attention on the course and the other riders as you try to bring your mount to the finish ahead of them.

pages.title: Red Strawberry
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Red Strawberry is a jumping challenge where you control a strawberry trying to clear a series of bars. Watch the jump bar at the top of the screen and time your mouse or touch input to get over the next barrier. Every successful clearance adds to the score, while failing to pass a bar ends the game.

pages.title: Arkadium's Classic Solitaire
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Arkadium's Classic Solitaire is a card-sorting game about clearing the board through carefully planned moves. Arrange cards into descending sequences while alternating colors, using the available plays to open further choices. Consider how moving a card affects the rest of the layout as you continue sorting, and aim to improve your score across further games.

pages.title: 2 Player Math
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: 2 Player Math turns arithmetic into a competition for two players. Choose from three difficulty settings and answer questions using the four basic operations, trying to respond quickly in the contest with your friend. The first player uses A, S and D to answer, while the second uses J, K and L. Work out the result before selecting your response.

pages.title: Matching Easter Egg
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Matching Easter Egg is a memory-card game about finding matching Easter egg pictures. Reveal the hidden images and remember where you saw each design as you choose the next cards. Use the mouse to interact with the cards, comparing the eggs you uncover and working through the matching task with the help of their remembered positions.

pages.title: Monster Trucks Hidden Wheels
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Monster Trucks Hidden Wheels is a hidden-object game featuring pictures of monster trucks. Find five concealed wheels in each image and click or tap their positions. Work through five levels, examining the pictures for the wheels that remain hidden. The objective is to locate the full set in the current picture before moving on to the next search.

pages.title: Intercity Bus Driver 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Intercity Bus Driver 3D gives you passenger-transport missions between cities. Drive along the freeways to reach the pickup location, collect your passengers and take them to the bus station at their destination. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, with the mouse handling interface interactions. Follow the transport task as you make the journey from one city's station to another.

pages.title: Demolition Cartoon Car Crash Derby
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Demolition Cartoon Car Crash Derby combines cartoon-styled cars with destructive derby driving. Take the car into the action and use its driving controls to line up crashes while keeping it moving. WASD drives, F activates nitro, C changes the camera and Space brakes. Switch your viewpoint or use the extra speed as you handle the car through the demolition challenge.

pages.title: Switches and Brain
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Switches and Brain is a logic puzzle about operating switches to light the required lamps. Press a control, observe the effect on the lights and work out which settings produce the result you need. Compare the positions of the switches and lamps as you try different combinations, using their changing states to solve the puzzle.

pages.title: Sandwich Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Sandwich Online is a food-stacking puzzle where you slide ingredients together to create a sandwich. Move the layers into place and combine them into the finished food, then eat the sandwich once it is ready. Complete levels to earn coins and unlock additional ingredients, giving you more items to assemble as you work through the sandwich-making challenges.

pages.title: BTS Ducks Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Ducks Coloring Book lets you choose a duck picture and give it your own colors. Select a shade for the brush, then apply it to the drawing with the mouse or touch controls. Try different color combinations across the image as you work toward your finished duck painting.

pages.title: Wheelie Bike 2
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Wheelie Bike 2 is a balancing challenge about riding a bicycle on one wheel for as long a distance as possible. Use the mouse to control the bike's balance and keep the wheelie going. Watch the bicycle's position as it moves, making the adjustments needed to continue riding without losing the balance that supports the one-wheel run.

pages.title: Brain Teaser
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Brain Teaser presents questions designed to catch you out when you answer in the usual way. Read the problem and look for a solution that considers more than the most obvious interpretation. Use the mouse or a finger to answer, working through challenges that draw on logic, memory, observation and quick reactions.

pages.title: Basketball Hero Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Basketball Hero Jigsaw offers twelve pictures to assemble from scattered puzzle pieces. Select an image and choose easy mode with 25 pieces, medium with 49 or hard with 100. Fit the pieces together to rebuild the scene, using the mouse or touch controls to position them. Choose a different picture or piece count when you want another jigsaw challenge.

pages.title: Defenders of the Realm : an epic war !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Defenders of the Realm : an epic war ! puts you in command of knights protecting a kingdom from monster attacks. Place troops to defend the castle across five lanes, watching for enemies entering from the right. Choose where the defenders are needed as the enemy army advances, adding units to the defense and keeping the creatures from overrunning the realm.

pages.title: Spore Hunter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Spore Hunter is a spaceship-defense game about shooting approaching space spores. Tap and hold to attack, keeping the ship protected while you deal with the incoming threats. You have three lives, with tapping also used for ship repairs. Collect power-ups to help increase your score as you continue defending the spacecraft.

pages.title: X Trench Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: X Trench Run puts you in a fighter ship flying through an enemy trench. Stay on course to avoid crashing, take out turrets and disable laser gates as you work toward the boss. The narrow route combines obstacle avoidance with attacks on enemy defenses, leading into boss encounters as you try to complete the space-combat run.

pages.title: Maths Fun
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Maths Fun is an arithmetic quiz about deciding whether the equation on screen is correct. Check the numbers and the displayed result, then select the true or false button to answer. Keep solving the equations while watching the countdown and try to build a higher score through accurate responses to the successive questions.

pages.title: Color Clash
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Color Clash is a color-matching game about moving colored shapes and matching blocks to complete the level. Use the left and right tap controls to adjust your play, checking the colors of the blocks as you work toward the matching goal.

pages.title: TicTacToe The Original Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: TicTacToe The Original Game is a turn-taking strategy game for X and O on a three-by-three grid. Place a mark in an empty square and try to make a straight line of three before the opposing side does. Horizontal, vertical and diagonal lines all count, so watch the opponent's possible connections while building your own.

pages.title: EG Last Battle
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Last Battle is a reflex game about striking flies with the character's hands and feet. Use mouse clicks or touch input to hit the flies and keep them from getting past your attacks. The game speeds up as you continue, making accurate timing more demanding as you try to destroy the next flies.

pages.title: Traffic Control
pages.creator: yupiy
pages.description: Traffic Control puts you in charge of the signals at busy roads. Tap the signal lamps to change the lights, deciding which traffic should move and which should wait. Keep vehicles from crashing while avoiding delays that leave drivers too frustrated. Work through the traffic missions by managing the flow and getting the cars through safely.

pages.title: Super Stacker 3
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Super Stacker 3 is a physics puzzle about arranging the supplied shapes into a stable stack. Position each piece so the structure can support the ones that follow, keeping the shapes from falling away. Work through forty levels with different arrangements and pieces to balance. The game also includes a speedrun option if you want to put your stacking pace to the test.

pages.title: Sisters Fashionista Makeup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Sisters Fashionista Makeup is a makeover game featuring Kendall and Kylie Jenner. Help the sisters design new makeup styles and try artistic looks on their faces. Use the mouse to make your choices and put together a finished design for each sister, experimenting with the available makeup options as you create their new appearances.

pages.title: Love Balls
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Love Balls is a drawing puzzle about making two balls meet. They drop from different starting positions in each level, so draw a solution that helps bring them together. Look at the space between the balls and think about where your drawing needs to guide them, reworking your approach for each new arrangement.

pages.title: School Day Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: School Day Preps is a makeover and dress-up game about getting a girl ready for school. Begin with her makeup, then choose an outfit for the day. Combine the available styling choices into a finished school look as you help her prepare to head out.

pages.title: Color Match
pages.creator: Duodezzzi
pages.description: Color Match is a puzzle game by Duodezzzi about a princess collecting flowers. Connect squares of the same color to remove matching blocks from the board. Find horizontal, vertical, or zigzag connections and work through the available colors as you help with her flower-gathering quest.

pages.title: Elisa Doll Creator
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Elisa Doll Creator lets you create dolls and dress them for different occasions. Put together a doll, then choose an outfit suited to the event in its life. Try different combinations as you style the dolls for their activities, working on both their creation and the clothing that completes each occasion's look.

pages.title: Space Jumper !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Space Jumper ! is an obstacle game about guiding a space paratrooper through a rapid freefall. Keep the character clear of the barriers in the way as you travel through space, looking for openings along the route. The challenge is controlling the descent through the obstacles and trying to push your record further on another attempt.

pages.title: The Pollywog
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: The Pollywog is an exploration game governed by a simple rule: larger creatures eat smaller ones. Move through the world looking for smaller creatures to eat while keeping clear of those bigger than you. Judge each encounter by the relative sizes, deciding when to approach and when to give another creature room as you continue exploring.

pages.title: Happy Swimmer Peixet
pages.creator: Fem jocs, Francesc Amador
pages.description: Happy Swimmer Peixet is an ocean obstacle game about helping Peixet reach the goal while dodging big fish. Make jumps to get past the threats and watch the available space before moving onward. Keep Peixet clear of the larger fish as you continue through the ocean toward the destination.

pages.title: Pregnant Princesses On Catwalk
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pregnant Princesses On Catwalk is a fashion-show dress-up game featuring two pregnant princesses. Help them choose outfits for the competition, trying different combinations to prepare each contestant's catwalk look. The show focuses on maternity fashion, with your clothing choices helping the two princesses compete to become the winner of the event.

pages.title: Samantha Plum: The Globetrotting Chef 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description:
Samantha Plum: The Globetrotting Chef 2 follows a chef on a hidden-object journey to find her father. Samantha's restaurant, The Loving Table, has just opened when a letter brings surprising news: her dad is alive.

Explore destinations including Rome, searching the scenes for concealed items and clues to his whereabouts. Follow the evidence through Samantha's travels as you help her work toward a reunion with her master-chef father.

pages.title: Ice Princess Roses Spa
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Ice Princess Roses Spa is a rose-themed spa and makeover game featuring Anna. Prepare a cream with rose petals and follow the game's treatment activities, then help her enjoy a flower-filled bath and a massage. The spa visit finishes with a makeover and dress-up choices. Work through the different activities to put together Anna's completed look after her spa day.
